# Farhan Shehzad

AI automation and integration engineer, based in Lahore, Pakistan (UTC+5),
working remotely. Five years building agents, pipelines and integrations for
recruitment, e-commerce and marketing operations.

Site: https://farhanshehzad155.github.io

## What this site contains

- Case studies on automation and platform work, each covering the problem, the
  constraints, the approach, the explicit scope of his contribution, and what
  did not work.
- A biography, full employment timeline, education and published research.
- A resume, in HTML and as a downloadable PDF.

## How claims on this site are classified

Every factual claim carries an evidence tier, and the build fails if a claim is
presented above the tier its evidence supports:

- Verifiable  a visitor can confirm it via a public link, which is always given.
- Measured    a first-party measurement, always shown with its stated basis.
- Counted     a first-party count, always shown with its scope and date range.
- Capability  a description of what he can do. Carries no numbers, by rule.

Most of the work described is internal to client systems and has no public URL.
Those case studies are written as engineering narrative rather than as demos.
Where an artifact is public, it is linked.

## Verifiable artifacts

- Proglo Shipping, a live multi-carrier shipping platform he worked on:
  https://www.progloshipping.com
- "Binned Term Count: An Alternative to Term Frequency for Text
  Categorization", Mathematics (MDPI), 2022.
